parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the mounting base of the faucet, made of stainless steel, which attaches the faucet to the wall or sink.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the internal plumbing connections.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the elongated part of the faucet through which water flows out, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water stream from the faucet to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs to adjust water direction.
